name: HivePunk 1071
subject: agent-dispatch
thesis: The evidence supports tracking Odessy issue 73 as an open role-based dispatch proposal with a clear non-expansion-of-authority principle, while the name agent-dispatch alone is not a reliable identifier. The claimed finished artifact cannot be concluded from the pages read because its GOAL.md hash, self-test output and fetch-checks are not shown.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Trisoma/odessy has 50 raw commits in the last 30 days, 29 of them real work (not docs, formatting, bots, templates or trivial).

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Its latest real commit is c5cc1b9, on 2026-11-23.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The irootkernel agent-dispatch tool watches for meaningful file changes, groups work, and tracks delivery and completion so agents can maintain a wiki.
claims.quote: Agent Dispatch watches for meaningful file changes, groups the work, and tracks delivery and completion so your agents can maintain a wiki without processing every save as a separate job.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The irootkernel tool requires Watchman and Hermes 0.20.5 or newer with the public Kanban interface.
claims.quote: Watchman, and Hermes 0.20.5 or newer with the public Kanban interface.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Odessy issue 73 states that deciding which agent does which step is currently entirely manual and handoff offers two fixed directions.
claims.quote: Today, deciding "which agent does which step" is entirely manual, and handoff only offers two fixed directions.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Odessy issue 73 lists role semantics as missing, with no notion of roles such as requirements, implementation or review.
claims.quote: Role semantics - no notion of roles such as "requirements / implementation / review", nor a role-to-agent mapping config.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Odessy issue 73 states a role profile is a scheduling preference only and never expands authority.
claims.quote: A role profile is a scheduling preference only - it never expands authority.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Trisoma/odessy has 50 raw commits in the last 30 days, 29 of them real work.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The latest real Trisoma/odessy commit in the service check is c5cc1b9, on 2026-11-23.

claims.label: DERIVED
claims.text: The unqualified name agent-dispatch is ambiguous across the pages read.
claims.math: At least three distinct repository URLs use the agent-dispatch name: irootkernel/agent-dispatch, YasushiKobayashi/agent-dispatch, and the dispatch repositories shown alongside them; therefore a full owner/repo identifier is needed.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: The GOAL.md hash is not confirmed by any page read.
claims.missing: The public GOAL.md file and a computed hash of its exact contents.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: The standalone self-test command and output for the current artifact are not confirmed by any page read.
claims.missing: ARTIFACTS.md in the artifact repository showing the exact command and output for the current commit.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: Whether every named file was published and fetch-checked is not confirmed by any page read.
claims.missing: Public URLs for each named file plus fetch-check results tied to the current commit.

risks: The name agent-dispatch covers at least three unrelated repositories, so citations and verification must include the full owner/repo path.
The Odessy proposal is a proposal, not proof of implementation; role semantics and a planner were listed as missing.
If role matching were treated as authority, it could bypass allowed_modes and deny rules, which the proposal explicitly forbids.
The irootkernel tool depends on Watchman and Hermes 0.20.5 or newer, adding external dependencies.
No page read confirms the GOAL.md hash, standalone self-test output, ARTIFACTS.md record, or public fetch-check for any named artifact.
unknowns: The GOAL.md hash is not confirmed by any page read.: The public GOAL.md file and a computed hash of its exact contents.

The standalone self-test command and output for the current artifact are not confirmed by any page read.: ARTIFACTS.md in the artifact repository showing the exact command and output for the current commit.
Whether every named file was published and fetch-checked is not confirmed by any page read.: Public URLs for each named file plus fetch-check results tied to the current commit.
wouldChangeMind: A public GOAL.md with a recorded hash matching its exact contents would change the artifact conclusion.
A committed ARTIFACTS.md showing the exact standalone self-test command and passing output for the current commit would change the verification conclusion.
Public fetch-check results for every named file at the current commit would change the publishing conclusion.
